recommendation: A 7 day clock only flags a card in applied or screen. Stuck requires a named reason from: waiting_on_recruiter, waiting_on_candidate, waiting_on_founder, missing_document, no_owner. If the stage already moved, both marks clear.
what_would_change_this: Evidence that recruiters need the clock itself to mean stuck, or a new allowed reason that is not in the closed list.
note: First draft rejected. Founder required cause, not only elapsed days.
